requirements.statement: Preview new draft paths without mutating target or current directory.
acceptance: Preview emits versioned safe relative paths.
Normal creation produces the same five files and preserves manual content.

requirements.statement: Preserve refusal and privacy boundaries for preview and creation.
acceptance: Existing files, directories and dangling symlinks are rejected.
Missing or symlinked specs directories are rejected; reports omit private content and absolute paths.

requirements.statement: Expose predictable help and argument handling.
acceptance: Help is read-only and exits zero.
Unknown or repeated flags and unsafe feature IDs exit 2.

decisions.summary: Use content-free versioned preview after destination preflight, preserving exclusive creation.

tasks.summary: Specify behavior and add isolated regression tests.
Document and validate Windows/Linux behavior and traceability.

checks.summary: Isolated CLI preview, mutation, refusal, privacy and argument checks.
